ai_summary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited has issued a regulatory filing informing stock exchanges about the dispatch of physical letters to shareholders whose email addresses are not registered. These letters provide instructions (web links and QR codes) for accessing the FY 2025-26 Annual Report and the notice for the 36th Annual General Meeting, scheduled for September 28, 2026. This procedural communication ensures compliance with SEBI regulations regarding shareholder access to essential documents, with no material financial impacts or red flags identified in this update.
